profiles.description: A repository-derived research ledger whose candidate records still require author confirmation before they become Claim Commons deposits.
A selected, source-grounded literature map. Co-authorship does not establish a person's precise contribution, and the records are not author-confirmed Claim Records.
A selected, source-grounded literature map. It is not an exhaustive bibliography or an author-confirmed account of individual contribution.
A selected claim map of lab-led work, methods, reviews, and large collaborations. The map separates these roles rather than treating co-authorship as a universal lab-level mechanism.
